'''Koon Odan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]], who worked for the [[Iridonia/Legends|Iridonian]] government.

==Biography==
Following the outbreak of a trade disagreement between [[Iridonia/Legends|Iridonia]] and [[Duro/Legends|Duro]], Odan was sent to [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]], to negotiate a treaty with the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] corporate official [[Belai Kaleeg]]. However, unknown to Odan, the Iridonian government also sent an [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] to Bespin, to kill Kaleeg and prevent the treaty from being signed. However, after the assassination attempt failed, the assassin was ordered to kill Odan instead.

==Skills and abilities==
She was fluent in [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], [[Bothese]], [[Durese/Legends|Durese]], [[Twi'leki/Legends|Ryl]], [[Rodese/Legends|Rodese]], and [[Zabraki|Zabrak]].<ref name="GoI" />
